title: What is Ahrefs MCP | Ahrefs for Developers
snippet:
**Ahrefs MCP** lets AI agents securely access the Ahrefs API and enrich their answers with real Ahrefs data. MCP (Model Context Protocol) is a standard that allows AI tools to connect with third-party APIs in a secure, consistent way. In our case, it connects AI tools with Ahrefs, enabling things like this:
![](/images/db704fd04a1f2149.jpg)
## Connect to Ahrefs MCP
Ahrefs provides a hosted MCP server that allows users with a Lite plan or higher to connect their Ahrefs account to supported AI tools. Once connected, your setup is synced and available across all devices linked to your personal or company account.
### Connection URLs
- **Streamable HTTP** (recommended): `https://api.ahrefs.com/mcp/mcp`
- **Legacy SSE** (deprecated in many tools): `https://api.ahrefs.com/mcp/mcpSse`
Most popular AI tools support connecting to the remote MCP directly. If you run into issues, check out our step-by-step setup guides:
- [Claude Web / Desktop](/en/mcp/docs/claude-desktop-web)
- [Claude Mobile](/en/mcp/docs/claude-mobile)
- [Claude Code](/en/mcp/docs/claude-code)
- [Copilot Studio](/en/mcp/docs/copilot-studio)
- [ChatGPT Web](/en/mcp/docs/chatgpt-web)
- [Lovable](/en/mcp/docs/lovable)
- [n8n](/en/mcp/docs/n8n)
- [Manus](/en/mcp/docs/manus)
- [Mistral's Le Chat](/en/mcp/docs/mistral-le-chat)
- [OpenClaw](/en/mcp/docs/manus)
## API limits and usage
The remote MCP server is available on **paid plans starting from Lite.**
- Each plan has a **maximum number of rows per request** that an AI agent can access.
- Each plan also comes with a **limited amount of monthly API units.** The higher your plan tier, the more units are included. Enterprise customers can purchase additional unit add-ons if needed.
- When a third-party app makes an API call on your behalf, it consumes **API units** from your monthly allowance — the [same way as direct API usage](https://docs.ahrefs.com/docs/api/reference/limits-consumption).
You can track your current usage in **Account settings → [Limits and usage](https://app.ahrefs.com/account/limits-and-usage/web).**

When you connect Ahrefs MCP to an AI agent:
- You’ll see an **authorization consent screen.**
- Once approved, the connection will appear in your account with a dedicated **API key** (tagged with `MCP` scope).
- Workspace admins can set a monthly API unit limit for each key in the [API keys report](https://app.ahrefs.com/account/api-keys) to prevent over-usage.
You can also:
- **Manually generate an MCP key** in your account and use it

title: Getting started with Ahrefs MCP
snippet:
The Ahrefs MCP server allows you to connect Ahrefs’ API to your AI tool of choice (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, etc.)
No code required. Just chat in plain English to pull SEO insights, analyze competitors, create dashboards, and more — all within your AI chat interface.
## **What is MCP?**
Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard that enables AI models to connect with third-party APIs in a secure, consistent way.
## **What can Ahrefs MCP help me do?**
By connecting Ahrefs MCP to your AI tool of choice, you can:
- Pull Ahrefs data directly into AI-generated answers
- Automate exports without touching the API or having technical knowledge
- Combine multiple data sources into one request (without writing a programming script)
- Connect with other MCP-compatible apps
## **Which plans allow usage of Ahrefs MCP?**
Ahrefs MCP is available to users on Lite and higher plans. Below is a table listing limits across the plans:
| **Plan / Limits** | **API units** | **Max rows per request** |
|---|---|---|
| Lite | 200,000 | 100 |
| Standard | 800,000 | 250 |
| Advanced | 2,000,000 | 500 |
| Enterprise | Custom | Unlimited |
### About monthly API unit limits and Max rows per request
Each time AI tools call Ahrefs API via the MCP, it consumes API units. **One API call costs a minimum of 50 units**, with the exact amount depending on the complexity of the request.
​
Learn more about [how Ahrefs API units consumption is calculated](https://docs.ahrefs.com/docs/api/reference/limits-consumption)
**Max rows per request** limits the number of results that can be returned in a single API call. This limit increases with higher calls.
To view how much API units you've already consumed for the month, go to [account settings](https://app.ahrefs.com/account/limits-and-usage/web).

## **Which AI tools can I connect to?**
You can use Ahrefs MCP with any AI tool that supports the Model Context Protocol. Popular options include:
- ChatGPT
- Copilot
- Lovable
- n8n
- Opencrawl
Note that each AI platform may have their own plan limits of what is required. [View the documentation](https://docs.ahrefs.com/docs/mcp/reference/introduction) for more detailed setup guides of setting up MCP for specific platforms.

### Does using the MCP server cost extra on top of my subscription?
There is no additional fee to use the MCP server itself, but it does consume the Integration API units included in your Ahrefs subscription plan.

Yes. The MCP server uses your private Ahref

OpenClaw | Ahrefs for Developers
snippet:
Follow these steps to add the Ahrefs MCP server to OpenClaw using `mcporter`.
- **Install mcporter**`npm install -g mcporter`. Alternatively, you can install it from the Gateway dashboard under Skills.
- **Add the Ahrefs MCP server**`mcporter config add ahrefs https://api.ahrefs.com/mcp/mcp`.
- **Generate an MCP token in Ahrefs.**
- Open the API keys report in your Ahrefs account: [https://app.ahrefs.com/account/api-keys](https://app.ahrefs.com/account/api-keys)
- Generate a new MCP key.
- Copy the token.
- **Add your MCP token to the mcporter config.** Run: `mcporter config list`. Locate the path to the `mcporter` config JSON file and open it. Add your MCP token as a Bearer token in the `Authorization` header:
```json
{ "mcpServers": { "ahrefs": { "baseUrl": "https://api.ahrefs.com/mcp/mcp", "headers": { "Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_AHREFS_MCP_TOKEN_HERE" } } }, "imports": [] }
```
- **Test the connection.** Example: `mcporter call ahrefs.keywords-explorer-volume-history country=us keyword=seo`. If the setup is correct, the request should return data.

This repository is no longer maintained! We have released a **remote Ahrefs MCP server**, which doesn't require local setup and works directly in popular AI tools. Learn more here: [Remote MCP server documentation](https://docs.ahrefs.com/docs/mcp/reference/introduction)
This repository is for the **local Ahrefs MCP server** which works with API v3 keys only. It **DOES NOT** work with MCP keys. It **IS NOT** maintained. It is **OUTDATED**. And we do not recommend using it.
# Ahrefs MCP
A Model Context Protocol server to connect Claude desktop and other compatible AI assistants to Ahrefs.
## Installation
`npm` commands need to be executed in a terminal:
- macOS: open the Terminal from your Applications folder
- Windows: press Windows + R, type `cmd`, and press Enter

### Install Ahrefs MCP Server
```
npm install --prefix=~/.global-node-modules @ahrefs/mcp -g
```
### Upgrading versions
If you've installed our MCP server before, and just want to upgrade, run this command:
```
npm install --prefix=~/.global-node-modules @ahrefs/mcp@latest -g
```
## Configuration
You can now add the Ahrefs MCP to your favourite AI assistant app by adding the `ahrefs` part to your app's configuration file:
```
{
"mcpServers": {
"ahrefs": {
"command": "npx",
"args": [
"--prefix=~/.global-node-modules",
"@ahrefs/mcp"
],
"env": {
"API_KEY": "YOUR_API_KEY_HERE"
}
}
}
}
```
### Specific for Windows OS
```
{
"mcpServers": {
"ahrefs": {
"command": "npx",
"args": [
"--prefix=C:\\Users\\YOUR_USERNAME_HERE\\.global-node-modules\\node_modules",
"@ahrefs/mcp"
],
"env": {
"API_KEY": "YOUR_API_KEY_HERE"
}
}
}
}
```
1. Take note of the double escape backslashes
2. Take note that the prefix directory is slightly different
3. Take note of the forward slash for `@ahrefs/mcp`
4. If you are working with Claude Desktop, run Ctrl-Alt-Del to open Task Manager and kill Claude Desktop. Otherwise, your newly changed config will not be loaded.

title: ChatGPT Web | Ahrefs for Developers
snippet:
Full support for MCP client access is currently in **beta** in ChatGPT. At the moment, it's only available in **Developer mode** for **Pro and Plus accounts on the web.**
While it's in beta, we recommend being as **explicit and precise as possible** in your prompts. For example:
- Mention the **Ahrefs MCP** directly.
- Specify the **tool or endpoint** to use.
- Indicate which **fields to pull** and how to **sort the results.**
- Excplicitly ask ChatGPT **not to use the web search.**
Better results often come from structured prompts like this:
*"Using the Ahrefs MCP connector and the `keywords-explorer-matching-terms` action, pull the top 10 keywords related to "marketing" in Brazil, sorted by search volume."*
instead of a vague prompt like:
*"What are the top keywords related to marketing in Brazil?"*

### Setup guide
Follow these steps to add Ahrefs MCP server to ChatGPT Web:
- Go to Settings > [Apps](https://chatgpt.com/#settings/Connectors) > Advanced settings ![](/images/67e525113397a606.png)
- Enable the "Developer mode". ![](/images/1135a4be576d23e4.png)
- Click the "Create app" button. ![](/images/b302c1baac463c7d.png)
- Fill in the new Connector details:
- MCP Server URL: `https://api.ahrefs.com/mcp/mcp`
- Authentication: OAuth
- Keep OAuth Client ID and Client Secret blnk
- Select the option “I trust this application” and click the "Create" button. ![](/images/1a73574b3e1d9013.png)
- Select your workspace and allow access to it by clicking "Allow". ![](/images/604c2392fdff59be.jpg)
- Check that the app in ChatGPT is successfully connected. ![](/images/5ffe0b5c70669b8b.png)
- Activate the Ahrefs connector in the chat before starting the query:
- Click on the "+" sign → "More"
- Enable the connector you created earlier. ![](/images/60d2f647a021dd2f.png)

title: 15 Ahrefs MCP Use Cases for SEOs & Digital Marketers
snippet:
With the recent launch of our remote MCP server, anyone can now chat directly with Ahrefs data to get actionable SEO insights.
MCP, which stands for Model Context Protocol, is an open standard that companies can use to integrate their external tools and data with compatible AI assistants.

The standard Ahrefs interface enables you to look up any site to uncover things like the keywords they’re ranking for, their most linked-to content, and how overall search traffic is trending.
Our new MCP server, which integrates with popular AI assistants like ChatGPT and Claude, offers the ability to automate these and countless other processes to gain insights at scale.

Available on Ahrefs Lite, Standard, Advanced and Enterprise plans, you’ll now be able to tap directly into our API without needing to know how to code.

---
